input: Draft a monthly client newsletter template

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Monthly Client Newsletter Template
gold.taskDescription: Create a reusable monthly newsletter template tailored to the user's clients, brand, and communication goals.

questions.title: What industry or type of business is this for?
questions.description: Understanding the industry shapes the tone, content sections, and relevance of the newsletter.

questions.title: Who are the clients receiving this newsletter?
questions.description: Knowing whether recipients are B2B professionals, retail customers, or another audience determines the appropriate voice and content depth.

questions.title: What is the primary goal of the newsletter?
questions.description: For example: retaining clients, sharing updates, driving sales, educating, or building brand loyalty.

questions.title: What sections or content types must be included?
questions.description: For example: company news, product updates, tips, case studies, upcoming events, or promotions.

questions.title: What platform will be used to send the newsletter?
questions.description: For example: Mailchimp, HubSpot, Outlook, or a PDF sent manually — this affects formatting requirements.

questions.title: Does the template need to match existing brand guidelines?
questions.description: Knowing if there are specific colors, fonts, logos, or tone-of-voice rules ensures the template fits the brand.

questions.title: What is the target length or word count per issue?
questions.description: This determines how many sections to include and how much detail each content block should contain.
